description: Send a WhatsApp message to a consumer and release thread control back to the agent. The body is the WhatsApp Cloud API message object - set `type` and the matching payload key (text, template, interactive, image, ...). This messages a real person: it is subject to the platform's send eligibility rules, and outside a 24-hour customer service window only an approved template will be delivered.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

text.description: Used when type is text, e.g. {"body": "Hello"}.

to.description: Consumer's WhatsApp number in E.164 format.

type.description: Message type, e.g. text, template, interactive, image.

name: mba_send_message
title: Send a WhatsApp message
